component.name: SWAI (SWitch AI)
component.summary: Native Linux local LLM model switcher & reverse proxy gateway

description.p: SWAI is a native Linux desktop application for starting, stopping, and monitoring local llama.cpp model servers — one at a time — from bash launch scripts. Written entirely in Rust with a GTK4 + Libadwaita native shell UI: no webview, no Electron, no Tauri.

ul.li: Start / Stop / Switch local llama.cpp model servers from a native GTK4 window with model cards.
System tray icon with quick-switch menu, window visibility toggle, and clean quit — works natively on KDE Plasma.
Context display — polls /slots to show token usage per model card, color-coded when approaching context limits.
Reverse proxy on a fixed local port so IDE/CLI clients never need reconfiguration when switching models.
Third-Party Inference Gateway — connect Claude Desktop and other inference clients via http://127.0.0.1:9080 with Anthropic Messages API support.
Live log viewer with auto-tail, clear, and export.

description.p: Flathub packaging support, AppStream metadata integration, and interactive Log Viewer controls (Close, Clear, Export).

screenshot.caption: SWAI main window showing model cards with ON/OFF toggles and context progress bars
